newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Acacia to sell zinc/lead stake to Western.
newsitem.headline: Acacia to sell zinc/lead stake to Western.

text.p: Acacia Resources Ltd said on Wednesday it will sell its 40.1 percent stake in the Blendevale zinc and lead project and associated interests in the Lennard Shelf area of Western Australia to Western Metals Ltd.
The Acacia siad the sale woudl allow it to concentrate on gold mining and exploration.
The purchase price is A$27 million in cash plus eight million Western Metals options with an exercise price of A$1.15, exercisable within five years of issue, Acacia said.

"The sale will allow Acacia to concentrate entirely on its core gold exploration and mining activities and ensures the continued strength of the company's financial position and the ongoing funding of an aggressive and successful A$30 million exploration programme in 1997," Acacia said in a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange.
